verdict: Ads are running but the conversion path is broken — zero leads this period.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns generated 294 clicks from $142.84 in ad spend, but zero leads were captured — website tracking confirms the clicks are arriving and stopping there, pointing to a break in the form or landing page, not the ads themselves. Nine planned setup milestones — covering landing pages, conversion tracking, and campaign infrastructure — are overdue by 14 to 45+ days, and that backlog is the direct cause of the conversion gap. We are working to close those milestones now: landing pages, tracking, and the full campaign structure are being completed this month. Once the conversion path is repaired, the traffic already flowing from ads will have somewhere to go, and lead volume should follow in the next reporting period.
